content: The GVM SD300D is a 300W bi-color COB LED monolight for studio and location work. Per the official GVM product page it offers a high color rendering index (CRI 97+) and a built-in efficient cooling fan with a stepped air intake, and supports convenient Bluetooth APP control. Photometric output (lux) is not published on the official page, so any illuminance value must be measured and recorded with explicit conditions (distance, CCT, reflector, power source) before being accepted.
